trigger: user explicitly names ChatGPT as the actor
user explicitly names AgentSwitchboard as the actor
user explicitly names the operator as the actor
a repository mutation can be performed by more than one actor and actor identity affects proof

steps.action: Resolve requestedActor from the current task. Explicit user wording outranks convenience. Use auto only when no actor is specified.
steps.gate: requestedActor is chatgpt, agentswitchboard, operator, or auto

steps.action: Run the actor-routing bind command before the mutation. For an explicit actor, selectedActor must equal requestedActor. Auto requires a recorded selection reason.
Perform the operation through the selected actor only. Do not substitute another execution path because it is faster or already available.
steps.gate: operation returns actor-owned evidence or a concrete failure

steps.action: Run the verify command with actualActor and the operation evidence reference.
steps.gate: execution-actor-receipt.json status is actor-verified and selectedActor equals actualActor

steps.action: Continue the owning workflow only after actor verification. If the selected actor cannot execute, preserve the binding and name the blocker; do not complete the task through another actor without a new explicit selection.

failureRecovery.mismatch: Fail closed, preserve the binding/receipt/report, do not claim the requested actor performed the operation.
failureRecovery.selectedActorUnavailable: Record blocker and dependency. A different actor requires a new explicit task decision or auto re-resolution when auto was originally selected.
